answer_1.quote: In the final step, DiNaM uses an LLM to find patterns of false information in each cluster and generate a matching disinformation narrative.
answer_1.outputs: Concise disinformation narratives (≤15 words) summarizing clusters of false claims

answer_2.quote: We compared the generated narratives with reference narratives from a testing dataset... using the Weighted Chamfer Distance.

answer_4.quote: The ground-truth narratives were manually created by experts from numerous fact-checking articles... Each article was annotated by two independent experts.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators reviewed articles to determine if all claims were false; narratives categorized into predefined disinformation topics.
